Shipped: test/e2e/create-space.spec.ts walks the door hop, the name/accent/offer steps and the two anonymous sinks (green on a dev server, 10/10 with funnel.spec.ts); proxy.ts makes the signed-out /spaces/new hop before the (main) layout; 44px phone targets on pills and chips; renders at 390/1280/1440/1920/2000 signed out and mocked signed in. The six postbuild gates run on the production build after merge (Vercel skips preview builds on this branch); a local build cannot reach them, it stops at the /discover/cities prerender without a reachable database.

Probe: node scripts/probes/create-space-hardening.mjs (static reads, spawns nothing).
